notes.title: August update
notes.content:
Additions:


Added new handicaps and skills

Added music

Added wild animals

Added harvestable wild plants

Added agility implants


Fixes:


Performance improvements

Some clone behavior improvements

Fixed issue with damage not being calculated correctly

Effects now clear when enemies respawn

Landmines now explode when shot

Fixed a bug where Nexus was not finishing construction properly

Fixed some more instances where clones would get stuck

Fixed nitrogen pump audio not stopping when no power

Game now keeps the custom resolution settings consistently

Fixed a bug where a silhouette of an enemy would continue to burn

Game now saves landmines and state of switched (on/off) objects

Streamer laser now hits where the crosshair dot is pointing

Increased flashlight brightness

Enemy missile mechs do not destroy themselves while firing anymore, armor and HP bumped

notes.title: Save system and more
notes.content:
Additions:


Added game saving and loading

Added tutorial

Added destructible trees

Added armor, shield and implant

Game length is now defined by number of waves instead of days

Added instigator building (call waves early)

Added stamina and oxygen meters

Added wave info UI


Fixes: 


Fixed some situations where clones would get stuck

Fixed a bug that caused weapons to stop working after the Streamer was unequipped

Fixed some instances where certain audio loops would not stop

Fixed some path-finding issues

Fixed a lot of things I forgot to write down

Fixed object pooler issue that was causing excess lag

Fixed bug that made bullet casings stop being removed

Fixed placement of farms

Fixed weather audio volume control
